cases.claim: “A diagnosis doesn’t define you. Even ATTR-cardiac amyloidosis. ... You have the power of choice.” | “People taking Attruby saw an impact on health-related quality of life…giving you more chances to do what you love with who you love.” | SUPER: “IMPACT ON HEALTH-RELATED QUALITY OF LIFE” | “It’s time to get busy livin’”
cases.context: Morgan Freeman VO; older man at retirement party and national park with family; upbeat song. Disclaimer: both arms experienced a decline in KCCQ-OS at 30 months.
cases.rationale: Suggests carefree life/return to pre-diagnosis and broad QoL improvement; KCCQ-OS and 6MWD declined in both arms; disclaimer does not mitigate.
cases.check: Judge: lifestyle/'carefree'/return-to-normal imagery in progressive disease where PI functional/QoL measures (e.g., 6MWT, KCCQ) still declined (slower decline ≠ improvement).
